# OpenViking Memory Server
OpenViking is the agent's local memory and vector database server backed by Ollama embeddings.

## Description
- Main process is `openviking-server.exe` launched with `--config ov.conf` via `start-server.bat`
- Uses Ollama for embeddings on port 11434; the server listens on port 1933
- Health endpoint `/health` returns `200 healthy` when running
- Holds memory `.md` files under `data/viking/default/user/default/` and vectors under `data/vectordb/`, plus `backend_meta.json`

## Relations
- Monitored and auto-restarted by the `watch-openviking.ps1` watchdog
- Backed up daily by `run-openviking-snapshots.ps1` into `skills/openviking-data/`

# OpenViking Watchdog
`watch-openviking.ps1` is the watchdog script that keeps the OpenViking memory server running.

## Description
- Polls every 5 minutes; detects OpenViking down and auto-launches `start-server.bat`
- `start-server.bat` starts Ollama (embedding) then `openviking-server.exe`
- Full restart needs ~15s (8s delay + Ollama warmup)
- Runs as Windows scheduled task `OpenViking-Watchdog`

## Significance
- Provides self-recovery: on 2026-11-09 it revived OpenViking at 16:58:02 after the snapshot task left it down
- On 2026-11-09 the snapshot wrapper's `finally` block also attempted a restart via `Start-OpenVikingIfDown`

# OpenViking Snapshot Backup
`run-openviking-snapshots.ps1` is the wrapper that snapshots and git-pushes the OpenViking memory data.

## Description
- Windows scheduled task `OpenViking-Memory-Snapshot` runs it daily at 03:00 with `-Reason scheduled -Push`
- Mirrors `data/viking/default/user/default/`, `data/vectordb/`, `backend_meta.json` into `skills/openviking-data/` (robocopy /MIR guard, zero-fill on memory `.md`)
- With `--commit --push`: `git add openviking-data` only, commits `chore(openviking-data): 全量快照 N files (reason)`, pushes `origin main` with retries
- Logs every run to `%TEMP%/openviking-snapshot/<timestamp>.log`

## Known Issues
- Push-success detection gives false negatives: on 2026-11-09 the snapshot + local commit `c9a15051` reached GitHub (ancestor of `origin/main` `d1e022e9`) yet the script reported push failure (EXIT 1), flagging the task failed
- Wrapper stops OpenViking for the vectordb copy, then restarts only `if ($wasRunning)` via `Start-OpenVikingIfDown`, which does NOT start Ollama and does NOT verify the server returned — causing OV to stay down (e.g. 2026-11-09 until watchdog revived at 16:58)

## Related Facts
- Raw exports in `memory-migration/out/` are 240 MB / 4359 files (cursor/workbuddy/opencode); copied into backup before commit
- Git remote `tyvt/skills.git`; node v22.23.2 available
